targetText: societies with state aid under the democratic control of the toiling people.
explanation: Marx mocks Lassalle's reliance on government loans from the Bismarckian state, insisting that real socialism arises from independent working-class revolutionary struggle.

targetText: insofar as they are the independent creations of the workers and not protégés
explanation: Co-operatives are valuable only when built independently by workers themselves, free from state subsidies or capitalist supervision.
